page.overview:
What is Coca-Cola?

Coca-Cola is a brand of soft drink that is known for its popularity. Coca-Cola made several promotions with LEGO between 2000 and 2002. 72 promotions were released; most of these sets are of the Studios and Soccer / Football themes.
